audit_items.proof_trace: handle_withdraw calls obligation.withdraw_ctokens (L328) before is_obligation_safe (L332), so the safety check reads the post-withdrawal ctoken balance; is_obligation_safe returns collateral_weighted_value >= borrow_weight_weighted_debt_value and the assert at L342 reverts the transaction if false. The only edge case (ratio = 1.0 exactly) is permitted by deliberate design (comment L1247) and is practically unreachable with decimal arithmetic.
